question: "The Odyssey" total domestic gross by August 31? (Higher Strikes)
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to how much "The Odyssey" box office will gross domestically by August 31, 2026. The "Daily Box Office Performance" figures found on the "Box Office" tab on this movie's The Numbers (https://www.the-numbers.com/) page will be used to resolve this market once the values for all dates between opening (July 17, 2026) and August 31, 2026 are final (i.e., not studio estimates).

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

Please note, this market will resolve according to the The Numbers figures provided under Box Office Performance until and including August 31, 2026, regardless of whether domestic refers to only the USA, or to USA and Canada, etc.

If there is ambiguity as to whether the resolution source's figures are final, this market will remain open until both https://www.boxofficemojo.com/ and https://www.the-numbers.com/ have confirmed their finalized figures.

If there is no final data available by September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, another credible resolution source will be chosen.
research:
I could only use data published on or before 2026-08-12, and I left out anything dated later. As of 2026-08-11, The Numbers had The Odyssey at **$472.16M** domestic. The lowest bracket starts at $490M, so the film needs about $18M more over the 20 days through August 31 to clear it. The question isn't settled yet.

## 1. Resolution source
- The source is the "Daily Box Office Performance" table on the film's The Numbers page. [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Odyssey-The-(2026)#tab=box-office)
- 2026-07-16: Thursday previews were $17.6M. The Numbers counts these in its running total.
- Daily figures and running totals from The Numbers, through the latest date allowed:
  - 2026-08-07: $8.83M
  - 2026-08-08: $12.42M
  - 2026-08-09: $10.46M (total $461.39M)
  - 2026-08-10: $5.17M (total $466.56M)
  - 2026-08-11: $5.60M (total **$472.16M**)
- Weekend totals I added up from those daily figures:
  - Opening (Jul 17-19): $123.5M
  - Weekend 2 (Jul 24-26): $90.0M
  - Weekend 3 (Jul 31-Aug 2): $51.0M
  - Weekend 4 (Aug 7-9): $31.7M

## 2. Current status
- 2026-08-11: The film was at $472.16M. To reach each bracket by August 31 it still needs:
  - $490M: about $17.8M
  - $510M: about $37.8M
  - $530M: about $57.8M
  - $550M: about $77.8M
  - $570M: about $97.8M
- Nothing has settled the outcome yet. That said, recent daily grosses put the "<490m" bracket under real pressure.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-09/10: Koimoi reported the film passed $450M in North America and became the second-biggest R-rated release. It also passed The Dark Knight Rises ($448.1M) to become Nolan's #2 domestic film. [Koimoi](https://www.koimoi.com/box-office/the-odyssey-box-office-crosses-450m-in-north-america-emerges-as-the-2nd-biggest-r-rate); [Comic Basics](https://www.comicbasics.com/?p=180633)
- 2026-08-09: The fourth weekend came in at an estimated $31.5M, behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day ($145M in its second weekend). [Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/08/09/arts/movies-box-office-spider-man/)
  - Worldwide gross was $1.1B.
  - IMAX domestic gross was $147.3M, the most ever for an IMAX domestic release.
  - The China opening is set for August 14, which doesn't count toward the domestic total.
  - Total ticket sales were running 18.5% ahead of last year.
- Late July: The second weekend came in at about $90M, a drop of only about 27%. [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/the-odyssey-box-office-massive-second-weekend-1236821417/); [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/the-odyssey-big-second-weekend-box-office-1236656039/)
- 2026-07-19: The opening was about $124M domestic and $264M worldwide. [Box Office Pro](https://www.boxofficepro.com/weekend-box-office-the-odyssey-shines-with-124m-domestic-264m-global-debut/)

## 4. Base rates / trajectory
- Weekend-to-weekend changes, from The Numbers daily figures:
  - Weekend 2: -27%
  - Weekend 3: -43%
  - Weekend 4: -38%
- The Monday and Tuesday after each weekend, compared with that weekend's total:
  - After weekend 3: $9.68M and $8.84M, together 36% of the weekend
  - After weekend 4: $5.17M and $5.60M, together 34%
- Weekday-to-weekday changes, comparing Mon/Tue Aug 10-11 with Aug 3-4: -47% and -37%.
- A simple projection, assuming later weekends drop 30-40% and weekdays keep their usual share:
  - **Wed-Thu Aug 12-13:** about $9-10M
  - **Weekend 5 (Aug 14-16):** about $19-22M
  - **Weekdays Aug 17-20:** about $11-13M
  - **Weekend 6 (Aug 21-23):** about $12-15M
  - **Weekdays Aug 24-27:** about $7-9M
  - **Weekend 7 (Aug 28-30):** about $8-10M
  - **Monday Aug 31:** about $1.5-2.5M
  - **Combined, that adds roughly $68-82M.** These are my own extrapolations, not a forecast. Holds tighter or looser than 30-40% would move the total by around ±$10-15M.
- Labor Day 2026 falls on September 7, so there is no holiday bump inside the window.
- Big Nolan and IMAX releases have usually held up well late in the summer. Oppenheimer's later weekends mostly dropped 30-40%. I didn't fetch a source for this; it comes from general knowledge.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-23: A mirror of the Polymarket "Higher Strikes" market showed "550 - 570m" leading at about 36% and "570m+" at about 33%. That snapshot is about three weeks old. [polymarkets.co.il mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/vi/market/the-odyssey-total-domestic-gross-by-august-31-higher-strikes-20260723204527748/)
- An Orrery "market moved" share page exists for the 530-550m bucket, but I couldn't find its date or price. [Orrery](https://orrery.me/share/move/will-the-total-domestic-gross-for-the-odyssey-be-between-530m-and-550m-by-august-31-20260724150841340)
- I found no Polymarket prices dated near 2026-08-12, and no Kalshi, Manifold or expert projections of the August 31 total.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-14 to 16: Weekend 5. Calendar listings show Flowervale Street and PAW Patrol 3 opening on Aug 14, along with smaller titles. Neither looks likely to take the premium large-format (PLF) and IMAX screens. [Bingebase](https://bingebase.com/releases/theatrical/august-2026)
- Spider-Man: Brand New Day is still pulling big crowds and is competing for PLF screens. [Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/08/09/arts/movies-box-office-spider-man/)
- 2026-08-21 to 23 and 2026-08-28 to 30: Weekends 6 and 7. I didn't check how the IMAX screens will be split between films during these weekends.
- After August 31: The Numbers usually swaps studio estimates for final figures within a day or two. The question resolves around September 2.
